prepared.title: Planning the Spring Glaze Workshop
prepared.text:
That works with a Tuesday class.

- **Bisque:** load Tuesday night after week 2, unload Thursday.
- **Glaze:** load Wednesday morning after week 3. It finishes Wednesday night and is cool by Thursday afternoon.
- That leaves almost five days of margin before week 4.

A 7 cubic foot kiln holds about 30 to 40 mugs in a glaze load, depending on the shelves. Sixteen pieces plus test tiles fit with room to spare, so you could add two more students later without a second firing.
